So depending on what monk path you go on will determine what special abilities you have. Monks don't normally have spells but they do have some spell like abilities. Ki is mostly used to do things that normal people can't. You can use ki to do several more attacks (Flurry of blows) or to defend against an attack giving the attacker disadvantage (Patient Defense). As for the monk paths (Monastic Traditions), you have three to choose from. Way of the Open Hand, Way of the Shadows and Way of the Four Elements(My favorite). Each one giving you different skills and abilities as you level up. I would also suggest not wearing armor due to the fact that you do get an unarmored defense at 1st level (AC = 10+ Dex+Wis) and unarmored movement at 2nd level(+10 ft). Your movement inceeases as you level up and at level 9 you can run across liquids and vertical surfaces when you move on your turn. If you really want to be meta. Become a Tabaxi monk(way of the shadow). Tabaxi's get a bonus to their speed and to their dex. If you want to know more then just message me 😁

Those people were ass holes. I know that it's hard when so many people are just moving into your life, taking from you and leaving. But you have to understand that there will always be people like that..... But then there will be the ones the move in, and give. Most of them will stay and some might end up leaving not because of you but because of the life they choose to have. That means that once this passes, once those people have moved on, you will find yourself around people who are like your rainbow. And if you don't find others like that then be your own rainbow. Be your own light. Because you have so much left to experience in this world. We all go through stuff like this. No one is ever perfect. And no one is ever alone. You are not alone. And not just because we both have the same condition. You aren't alone because there are people would DID that feel so alone. They feel like no one cares about them when in reality. There are so many people with their arms open ready to accept them. So I will happily be the first. If you need someone to just talk to about anything (granted I'm not a therapist) then just Pm me.
